reading: the broadcast per-frame calibration, with its gates tuned on real TV footage (track ≥ 85% inlier, anchor landmark ≥ 70%), does not accept the FC 26 picture even when the starting homography is verified correct (0.17 m). The game's lines are thinner and the line-pixel map differs from real broadcast; the fit scores 73% on the exact anchor frame. Loosening the gates for game footage would be pipeline tuning against a synthetic source and is not done here.
consequence: FC 26 cannot be shown in the panel through the moving-camera path today. The static-camera path needs a fixed camera, which FC 26's broadcast view is not. Game footage remains a detector check only (players detected well: see fc26-x5-screen-capture.json).
what_would_work: an FC 26 camera preset that does not move (e.g. 'Tele Broadcast' with zoom/height fixed at the maximum and no auto-follow — not available in the game as far as known)
a real match from a fixed camera (the system's design target; SoccerTrack rehearsals 990731/990741 show the full chain)
